_apa_ini: How much book-membership signal the chunk text actually carries, measured with a simple classifier.
model: logistic regression on word 1-2 gram TF-IDF, CPU, seed 42

dua_cabang_interpretasi.bila_akurasi_mendekati_baseline: the program-membership signal is not recoverable from the chunk text; the premise is then a measured result, and the failure of the text rerankers follows from the channel, not from a weakness of the models
dua_cabang_interpretasi.bila_akurasi_jauh_di_atas_baseline: the signal is in the text and a trivial classifier recovers it, so the failure of the instruction-following rerankers is sharper: they fail to use information that is there

batasan: the classifier sees the whole chunk as a standalone document, while a reranker judges query-document relevance; this is an upper bound on the available signal, not a simulation of the reranker's task
